Show dorsal/back of right hand toward camera with thumb viewer-left and fingertips up, arm down. Five distinct fingers gently separated by clear visible gaps, nearly straight relaxed neutral pose, natural unequal digit lengths and rounded fingertips. Slight 3/4 dorsal angle to communicate thickness while avoiding foreshortening. Full clean silhouette and full bare forearm end with generous margins. Detached game asset with clean neutral model boundary, no injury. Plain light gray background, diffuse neutral studio light, crisp detailed clean grounded stylized FPS art. No left hand, pair, torso, weapon, stand, ruler, labels, logos, tattoos, jewelry or watermark. No jacket anywhere.
